name: code_reindex
description: Rebuild the code index of the calling session's own repo (runs gitnexus analyze detached; its output is captured to <data>/code-index/<slug>/analyze.log). Returns after the first tick -- outcome "started" (lock held, process alive, output seen), "up-to-date", "starting" (running, no tick yet), "already-running", or "not-started" with a typed reason (npx-not-found, gitnexus-not-found, analyze-failed, spawn-failed, remote-member). Poll code_status for completion. Scope: always the calling session's own repo -- a member session uses its registered work folder, any other session the fleet server's working folder; there is no repo/path scope argument. Fails with E-SELF-NO-WORKFOLDER or E-SELF-NOT-A-REPO when that folder is missing or is not a git repository, E-CODE-INDEX-NOT-READY when it has no code index yet or the index is still building, and E-CODE-INTEL-DISABLED when code intelligence is off (each with a one-line remediation).
